title: Amazon Isn’t Waiting for Black Friday. Here’s What’s Already on Sale
author: Les Shu
text: All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.You can’t blame people for shopping at Amazon during the holiday season, especially if they are Prime members (yay, two-day shipping). Unless you have qualms about buying from the retailer, Amazon’s Black Friday deals start on November 19—much sooner than the traditional day after Thanksgiving. But the company has already discounted many items ahead of its own sale, including things we’ve tested and recommend. You should wait for potentially bigger discounts during Black Friday, but if your wallet is itching, here are a few products that caught our attention.Check out our guide to the Best Early Black Friday Deals, plus standing desk deals, appliance savings at Home Depot, and early tech deals.Amazon Early Black Friday Tech DealsPhotograph: Ryan WaniataSonyWH-1000XM6$460 $378 (18% off) Amazon$458 $378 (17% off) Walmart$458 $378 (17% off) Best BuyWith a WIRED rating of 9 out of 10, the XM6 is one of our favorite over-ear headphones, combining comfort with great sound quality and noise cancellation. This is the lowest price on Amazon; however, it has dropped to this price before. Note that Walmart and Best Buy are also offering the XM6 at this sale price.Photograph: AlamyPhotograph: James D. Morgan/Getty ImagesAppleAirTag (2nd Generation)$29 $23 (21% off) Amazon$99 $70 (29% off) Amazon (4-Pack)The AirTag seems to be on sale all the time, but no matter—it’s currently the lowest price on Amazon and cheaper than buying from Apple. It’s one of the best Bluetooth trackers. These are well-regarded among WIRED testers, but we recommend waiting until after Thanksgiving to see if they drop further—don’t worry, they are often on sale.Courtesy of Best BuyAmazonFire HD 10$155 $73 (53% off) AmazonIs it on sale or clearance? The arrival of new Alexa tablets spelled the end of the Fire series, known for being budget-friendly. The Fire HD 10 is our pick for the best Fire tablet, so if you want to grab one before they’re gone, now is a better time than any. Don’t worry about buying a brick: Amazon says it will support Fire tablets for another four years.Courtesy of BlinkAmazonBlink Mini Pan-Tilt 2K+$50 $20 (60% off) AmazonMost PopularGearThe Best VPNs That Actually Protect You OnlineBy Jacob RoachSmart HomeRing’s Indoor Drone Camera Is Back—and Now Powered by AIBy Julian ChokkattuGearWorld Models Will Soon Be Inescapable. Here’s What You Need to KnowBy Reece RogersComputersThis New Linux-Based Desktop Operating System Is Built for AI NerdsBy Reece RogersYou can expect Amazon’s own devices to go on sale during Black Friday. While Blink’s security cameras didn’t make our shortlist, WIRED reviewer Simon Hill still thinks they’re worth considering, especially if you’re on a budget. A downer is that they only work with Alexa, but if that’s you, it’s NBD. Like so many companies, Amazon has increased prices on its products. The latest version of its pan-tilt camera is usually $40, but it’s 50 percent off right now.Courtesy of AmazonSoundcore by AnkerBoom 2 Plus Portable Speaker$250 $170 (32% off) AmazonWIRED’s audio editor won’t stop praising Soundcore products, but he’s not wrong: This nascent brand (soon to be rebranded as Anker, its parent company) makes terrific audio products without the premium price. WIRED reviewer Louryn Strampe included this Bluetooth boombox in a roundup of her favorite festival gear. It’s the lowest price ever on Amazon currently, but it’s not the cheapest—keep an eye out at other retailers during Black Friday.Amazon Early Black Friday Home and Kitchen DealsPhotograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: Molly HigginsLevoitVital 200S-P Air Purifier$190 $170 (11% off) Amazon$190 LevoitWhy should you trust us for the best air purifier recommendation? Because WIRED reviewer Molly Higgins literally filled her home with smoke to find the best models, and this one from Levoit is her pick as the best cheap air purifier. Yet, this De’Longhi fits the bill. One of our recommended models, it usually costs around $200 or just a little more, but you can snag one for $150 if you’ve been wanting to get into the third-wave coffee game.
